collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A young sculptor wants to carve ordinary people instead of heroes for the village square: let them, or ask for a hero.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been asked to carve a statue for the village square. Everyone expects a famous founder. (subject) wants to carve an ordinary fisher mending a net. (friend), on the council, says statues are for heroes. What should the village do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) carves the fisher. It is so lifelike that people stop to say hello to it. The real fishers love it. (friend) admits, after a while, that the fisher is a hero too.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) carves the founder, beautifully, and carves a small fisher at the founder's feet, mending a net. Nobody asked for it. Everybody loves the fisher best.
